acceptance: Reproduce: hold a live adapter connection, call test_connection(), and show whether the held session is stopped.
Fix so test_connection only stops a session it created itself.
A regression test covers test_connection with a live session.
context: Noticed while fixing create_connection after drop-database; not touched there. Local only.
description: SparkAdapter.test_connection() calls spark.stop() on a session from getOrCreate(). When a session is already live in the process, getOrCreate() returns that same session, so the check would stop it, the same class of defect fixed for create_connection/close_connection in the Spark dagScheduler fix.
